sources.title: Food Composition Table for Bangladesh, first edition
sources.publisher: Institute of Nutrition and Food Science and Centre for Advanced Research in Sciences, University of Dhaka; supported by Bangladesh government and international partners
notes: FAO/INFOODS lists the 2013 PDF and Excel version, but this review did not establish a data-reuse license.
Do not copy values into the app until reuse terms and the newer database status are confirmed.

sources.title: Development of a new food composition table: An updated tool for estimating nutrient intake in Bangladeshi population
sources.publisher: Food Chemistry; authors affiliated with University of Dhaka, FAO, and ICMR-National Institute of Nutrition
notes: The paper describes a database of 447 foods and 89 components; primary analytical values were generated for 74 foods, including 54 prioritized key foods, with other values drawn from analytical, estimated, borrowed, or calculated sources.
Preserve the value-level method and source; the article abstract is not a substitute for access to the underlying data or permission to redistribute it.

sources.title: Department of Agricultural Marketing market-price reports
sources.publisher: Department of Agricultural Marketing, Government of Bangladesh
notes: The official interface exposes locality, market, price type, and date filters and print/PDF reports.
A location and collection date must be selected; do not treat an unfiltered national display as a household's local price.
This review did not find an explicit reuse license or API contract; do not scrape or redistribute automatically until terms are confirmed.

sources.title: Bangladesh - Food Prices
sources.publisher: World Food Programme Price Database, distributed through the Humanitarian Data Exchange
notes: The downloaded CSV includes market, admin areas, date, commodity, unit, price type, currency, price, and price flag.
Observed units are heterogeneous (including KG, 100 KG, L, and 1 piece); preserve source units and never silently normalize them.

The 1900 date needs investigation before use. The newest row in the reviewed snapshot is 77 days before the review date; a small excerpt is shown only as a historical visual, never as a current quote or planner price.
Use attribution and keep row-level source/date/unit/market provenance if this candidate is used.

sources.title: AgriPriceBD: A Daily Market Price Dataset of Agricultural Commodities of Bangladesh
sources.publisher: Dataset authors affiliated with University of Dhaka and Southeast University; published on Mendeley Data
notes: The dataset page describes five commodities and a five-year daily series with BDT/kg retail and wholesale minimum/maximum prices.
Its metadata says daily government PDF reports were digitized with an LLM-assisted pipeline and documents four zero-price green-chili records in January 2024 due to portal outages.
Review the files and compare extracted records with original DAM reports before any AharAI use; this coverage does not replace local validation for AharAI's listed foods.
